$comment: When and how to use the Menu. The component is src/styles/components/menu.css with behaviour in src/lib/menu.ts, built from Figma "Foundation – UI 2" (Menu item, node 46:492; Menus, node 46:588). Shown on the Menu page and published to public/llms.txt by `npm run tokens`.
intro: Menus list actions or options in a panel that opens from a button or a dropdown. Items are 24px tall, with an optional 12px icon before the label and an arrow after it when they open a submenu.

itemStates.label: Default
itemStates.usage: No fill, label in --color-text-default, icons in --color-icon-secondary (lead) and --color-icon-default (arrow).

itemStates.label: Hover
itemStates.usage: --color-bg-hover-light fill (lighter than --color-bg-hover, which reads too strong in a list), for the pointer and for keyboard focus alike, and on an item whose submenu is open.

itemStates.label: Disabled
itemStates.usage: --color-bg-secondary fill, label and icons in --color-bg-disabled-secondary. Set aria-disabled="true".

rules: Use createMenu() (src/lib/menu.ts) for the markup and behaviour: <div class="menu" role="menu"> with <div class="menu__item" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">. Add menu--floating for a menu that opens over content.
Use a Menu for actions, and a Dropdown (which opens a Menu as a listbox) for picking a value.
Keep labels short and on one line. Give every item a lead icon, or none.
An arrow after the label means the item opens a submenu. Keep to one level of submenus.

Submenus open when the pointer rests on their item for 300ms. The wait is a debounce: it restarts every time the pointer moves to another item, so passing over items doesn't flicker submenus open and shut. A click or Arrow Right opens them at once.
Floating menus scale in from their trigger over 200ms with a strong ease-out and close faster (120ms). Opened from the keyboard, they appear instantly.
Keep disabled items visible to show an action exists but isn't available now; use aria-disabled="true", not removal.
